newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium barely changed as dollar falls.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium barely changed as dollar falls.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed little changed on Wednesday, with the dollar's decline offsetting a firm close in London overnight, traders said.

"Though we saw prices rise on LME, Tokyo could not move up because of the strong yen (compared with Tuesday)," said a trader. "I wouldn't be surprised if LME prices moved upwards as the (U.S.) economy is faring well and stocks are low."
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen higher to 0.2 yen lower, with benchmark April 1998 drifting down 0.2 yen to close at 207.8 yen per kg.
The day's trade volume was 2,163 lots, up slightly from 2,043 lots on Tuesday.
